the annihilation cross-sections for neutralinos below the W+W-, tbar t thresholds are not suppressed, and that they are not negligible in the case of the Sun and Earth.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the neutralino annihilation cross section into three-body final states is much larger than the two-body annihilation cross section, which is usually used to study the neutralino dark matter.
, for neutralino masses below the W+W-, tbar t thresholds, we can obtain a large annihilation cross section into three-body final states.
the annihilation cross sections for three-body final states are larger than those for two-body final states in the mass ranges of interest.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the energetic-neutrinos from neutralino annihilations in the Sun and Earth can be enhanced in the region of parameter space where the W+W- channel is open, but the W+W- cross section is suppressed.

the energetic neutrino signal from neutralino annihilations in the Earth and Sun can be significantly enhanced below two-body thresholds, and that this enhancement can occur over a large region of supersymmetric parameter space, especially for large tan β.

the annihilation of neutralino dark matter into energetic neutrinos can be a significant source of neutrinos in the Sun and Earth, and can be used to constrain the parameter space of neutralino dark-matter candidates.
